issue.title: Make artifact-link full reconcile interruptible including first-store reduction
issue.description:
## Feature proposal

Make a full artifact-link reconcile interruptible, including the first-store
reduction inside `preview_reconciled_aggregate`.

The 2026-11-27 10:33 apollo digest (plan
`plan:202611/artifact_link_job_budgets.md`) timed bob-cli's full reconcile at
88–102s. `preview_reconciled_aggregate` only checks the deadline between
stores, so reducing the first store cannot stop mid-store. Under load the
chop used to start that ~100s step with ~65s of budget left and die at the
300s axe timeout.

## Why this is out of scope

`plan:202611/artifact_link_job_budgets.md` only refuses to start a full
reconcile unless remaining budget covers the learned estimate times a 1.5
margin (or a priority tick skips the sweep so reconcile gets the whole
budget). Making the reduction itself cancelable is the base-cost work that
plan left as follow-up.

issue.creation_reason: The approved job-budgets plan names the ~100s uninterruptible first-store reconcile reduction as an out-of-scope cost driver. File this so cancelable reduction is tracked separately from the estimate-margin gate that just landed.
